name: youeye-market
description: YouEye Market catalog and per-app manifests. Tests use node:test; the build and its tests use the generator of a YouEye checkout (YOUEYE_ROOT).

scripts.build: if [ -z "$YOUEYE_ROOT" ]; then echo 'build: set YOUEYE_ROOT to a YouEye checkout; the generator is control-panel/scripts/market-build.ts there' >&2; exit 1; fi; repo="$PWD"; rm -rf out && cd "$YOUEYE_ROOT/control-panel" && node --import tsx scripts/market-build.ts "$repo" --out "$repo/out"
